subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The science club used the case to explain conservation.”?
options: The school taught children a song about saving water.
Usually, people think about water only when it stops running.
The school held a poster contest about saving energy.
Saving water was not only about shorter showers or closing taps.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The school taught children a song about saving water.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Usually, people think about water only when it stops running.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The school held a poster contest about saving energy.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The science club used the case to explain conservation. Saving water was not only about shorter showers or closing taps.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
